responsibility: This file provides the tiny shared data definitions used by both the linker plugin side and the lto1 front end to render LTO symbol metadata in human-readable form. It owns the canonical string tables for LTO symbol kind, ELF visibility, and linker-resolution enums, supplying the textual names consumed by diagnostics, dumps, and plugin/LTO coordination code without implementing the higher-level streaming or merge logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the common pair: it defines the shared LTO/plugin string tables for symbol kind, visibility, and linker resolution names, whereas gcc/lto/common.h only provides the lightweight header-level resolution-name table interface.
